country.evidence_quote: Amy is a Fargo, ND native. She hails from NDSU with a degree in Political Science. She joined FBS in 2019 as a Trainer via the United States Senate. She is eagerly learning the system and enjoys sharing knowledge, tips and training expertise with new and current users of Flexmls. In her off hours, she is a boy mom/hockey taxi, enjoys MN lake life and loves yellow labs.

contact.name: Amy Long
contact.evidence_quote: Good morning, everyone, and good afternoon to those of you who are not in my time zone. Welcome to today’s webinar covering working with contacts in Flexmls. My name is Amy Long and I am your trainer. Today I’m joining you from Fargo, North Dakota and it’s a beautiful summer morning. I hope I find you all doing well in your respective places around the country.

alternates.name: Josh Hernandez
alternates.evidence_quote: [Josh is a Flexmls trainer at FBS.] ... Good afternoon, everybody. My name is Josh Hernandez. And today, I am going to be going over some of the options you have on the contact management screen as far as seeing what information displays at a glance when you go to that screen, as well as adding or importing contacts. Let’s look at the topics we’ll use today.
alternates.why_chosen: Other role. Josh Hernandez is a trainer at FBS who demonstrates how to use the Flexmls system and manage contacts.
